measurementProtocol.edgeMetric: per-row display RGB8 luma 10–90% edge spread, median over rows
measurementProtocol.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap interval over rows (2000 deterministic resamples), plus an eight-offset bilinear subpixel resampling phase envelope
measurementProtocol.toleranceMeaning: Quarter-display-pixel resolution floor only; not a physically derived optical tolerance.
measurementProtocol.predictedOrdering: Canonical major-radius ordering is a screening bound; no direct equivalence to measured edge width is assumed.

sharpnessRank.limitation: This rank is descriptive; edge spread contains pixel phase, native raster, silhouette, and display mapping effects. It is not a calibrated CoC-to-PSF transfer.

phaseSweep.method: re-sample the captured display crop at eight fixed horizontal subpixel offsets using bilinear interpolation

uncertainty.interpretation: row-bootstrap interval is conditional on this raster; phase envelope is descriptive and does not include scene/capture variance

limitations: v5 is an earlier SwiftShader/display capture set; it is not the v6 Apple Metal hardware capture.
Only processed images were saved for these movement cases, so no matched Raw baseline is available.
The images are 480x361 CSS captures resized to the recorded 480x360 measurement grid.
Pairwise edge results are inconclusive when bootstrap and pixel-phase bounds overlap.
The fixture is diagnostic geometry, not the original room scene.
